sources.title: Afghanistan travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live country guidance has a Regular Canadian passport section. It says a visitor visa is required but current entry and exit are severely restricted, so it does not establish a stable usable issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All travel to and out of the country is severely restricted.

sources.title: Central African Republic travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Central African Republic destination page states the tourist-visa requirement for a Regular Canadian passport, but does not identify where or when the visa is issued.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Guinea-Bissau destination page states the tourist-visa requirement for a Regular Canadian passport, without an actual issuance-time rule.

sources.title: Liberia travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Liberia destination page states the tourist-visa requirement for a Regular Canadian passport. It does not map Canadians to a current electronic, mission or arrival issuance route.

sources.title: Sudan travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Sudan destination page addresses the Regular Canadian passport tourist-visa application timing, but does not state an actual issuing point or confirm a stable operational route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Allow at least 2 months between your visa application and the intended date of travel.

sources.title: Iran travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Iran destination page states the tourist-visa requirement for a Regular Canadian passport. Its generic information does not establish Canadian eligibility for an electronic or border-issued visitor visa.

sources.title: North Korea travel advice and advisories
sources.jurisdiction: Canada / Democratic People's Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live DPRK page describes third-country mission processing after Pyongyang approval, while directly warning that borders remain closed to travellers from most countries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: North Korea’s borders have been closed to travellers from most countries since 2020.

sources.title: Turkmenistan travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: Canada's live Turkmenistan destination page says a Regular Canadian passport tourist visa requires an invitation letter, a material individual condition that prevents an unconditional visitor-route classification.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You must present a letter of invitation in support of your visa application.

unresolved.reason: Canada says a tourist visa is required, but all travel to and from Afghanistan is severely restricted and regular entry requirements may not apply. No stable ordinary Canadian visitor issuance route is inferred.
